description: Trend and volatility regime. Market regime from the last 24 hours of hourly candles (cached 5 minutes): trend (up / down / range, EMA50 vs EMA200), volatility bucket (low / normal / high / extreme by ATR%), RSI, EMAs. Use this for risk sizing or entry timing (e.g. avoid new entries while volatility is 'extreme') alongside get_signal_bias for direction and get_support_resistance for levels — on its own it gives context, not a trade direction. symbol uses the same trend/volatility thresholds for every instrument, so regime readings are directly comparable across symbols (e.g. BTC 'high' and SOL 'high' mean the same ATR% bucket). Costs $0.005 USDC per call (x402).
name: get_market_regime
